newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: AIR confirms 98.76 pct take-up of rights issue.
newsitem.headline: AIR confirms 98.76 pct take-up of rights issue.

text.p: Air New Zealand on Monday confirmed that 98.76 percent of shareholders took up its rights offer which closed on November 15.
Air NZ said the level of take-up raised an additional NZ$238.9 million of share capital.
All shares were allotted on November 22.

"As provided for in the prospectus, Air NZ directors intend to make a private placement to institutional investors of 3,876,749 shares (including shares not taken up under the Rights Issue) to round out to the maximum permitted 49 percent, the proportion of B shares on issue," Air NZ said in a statement.
Following the Rights Issue and private placement, Air NZ's share capital will comprise:
